item.text: Ho ricavato una gerarchia mista: root e servizio sono IPv4, i due autoritativi di `test.` sono IPv6, mentre il resolver è dual-stack. Procedo quindi con glue A/AAAA secondo ciascun server e con il trasferimento `pc3 → pc9` esclusivamente su IPv6.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- lab.conf '*.startup' && for zone_spec in 'root pc2/etc/bind/db.root' 'test pc3/etc/bind/db.test' 'services.test pc12/etc/bind/db.services.test'; do set -- "'$zone_spec; if command -v named-checkzone >/dev/null; then named-checkzone "$1" "$2"; else echo "named-checkzone unavailable: $1"; fi; done
for conf in pc2/etc/bind/named.conf pc3/etc/bind/named.conf pc9/etc/bind/named.conf pc11/etc/bind/named.conf pc12/etc/bind/named.conf; do if command -v named-checkconf >/dev/null; then named-checkconf "$conf"; else echo "named-checkconf unavailable: $conf"; fi; done
git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- lab.conf '*.startup' && for zone_spec in 'root pc2/etc/bind/db.root' 'test pc3/etc/bind/db.test' 'services.test pc12/etc/bind/db.services.test'; do set -- "'$zone_spec; if command -v named-checkzone >/dev/null; then named-checkzone "$1" "$2"; else echo "named-checkzone unavailable: $1"; fi; done
for conf in pc2/etc/bind/named.conf pc3/etc/bind/named.conf pc9/etc/bind/named.conf pc11/etc/bind/named.conf pc12/etc/bind/named.conf; do if command -v named-checkconf >/dev/null; then named-checkconf "$conf"; else echo "named-checkconf unavailable: $conf"; fi; done

Completata la gerarchia DNS richiesta.

- Ruoli: `pc2` root, `pc3` primario `test.`, `pc9` secondario, `pc12` `services.test.`, `pc11` resolver ricorsivo.
- Aggiornati solo gli `[image]` DNS in [lab.conf](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-am43fbxl/lab/lab.conf).
- Create configurazioni BIND, deleghe/glue, record richiesti e AXFR limitato a `pc9`.
- `pc11` usa esclusivamente root hints interni, senza forwarder e con DNSSEC disabilitato.
- `pc4` e `pc6` usano rispettivamente il resolver IPv4 e IPv6 in [pc4.startup](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-am43fbxl/lab/pc4.startup) e [pc6.startup](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-am43fbxl/lab/pc6.startup).
